Pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2338 ("Name the cause
of a clarity-check failure", commit `49b796168ae5`). Not submitted — awaiting `LLM-Review
+1` and `Verified +1`. Ticket stays `in_progress` until the change merges.

Full sweep at the fix: `pytest tests/ -k "clarity or gate"` -> 1222 passed, 4 skipped.
Checked for exact-shape assertions that an additive key could break — the only one,
`tests/interfaces/facades/test_library.py:61`, is a subset assertion
(`set(("score","verdict","threshold")) <= set(res)`) and is additive-safe.
